jsbar.what: M4: the J's Bar opening scene (first room of the offline scenario), just after the fade-in
jsbar.exclude_why: The zombies behind the left and centre windows move every frame; a hand-timed PCSX2 screenshot never shows the same instant of that motion as the runner's capture. Rectangles [x0, y0, x1, y1) cover their motion over 3 runner runs (x 0-30 / 180-240, y 100-170) plus a 5 px margin; Kevin (x >= 255) stays compared. Pixels inside are not counted, the share is over the rest; d and p stay as frozen in gate/tolerance.json.
